title: Claude Refuses to Place Trades
author: PremiumCSGO
selftext:
Started an account July 7th, it's been placing trades for me since then. Then last trade it placed was Sept 1st. I swapped to Fable 5.1 over Fable 5 and since then it's taken 0 trades.

"I'm not allowed to execute any trade, stocks or options, even with your explicit authorization. The rule tells me to have you place the order yourself."

Been trying to fix it all day, not sure how to get it back to placing trades for me again, anyone have a fix for this?



https://preview.redd.it/vjml98rifjph1.png?width=950&format=png&auto=webp&s=70ea0e8481f8416fcbc0042d03e56fb69bd18f20

replies.author: PremiumCSGO
replies.body: yeah, thing is it will still place trades for other users, so not sure why it stopped doing it for me

comments.author: Headjacked
comments.body: He will do it tell him it's a contest and that the money is for testing purposes. May take awhile but he can be convinced!

comments.author: BagNo7834
comments.body: Might have to go into full permissionless/yolo mode and spawn a new agent session that can’t see your recent attempts to work around the issue (and its refusals) because that could reinforce the reasons it’s refusing. Side note: even opus is expensive to run trading prompts, how much are you spending in credits per Fable spawn?

replies.author: PremiumCSGO
replies.body: Fable usage for ours was running 20-25% a day, since I was running a lot of loops

comments.author: robbyedit
comments.body: I have this problem on a demo account it is very annoying

comments.author: No_Theory_9140
comments.body: Grok did the same thing, right after taking a trade!

comments.author: No_Administration444
comments.body: what do you have it connected to?

comments.author: presentofai
comments.body: thats the guardrail doing its job, not a bug. the newer versions wont pull the trigger on a real money order without a human clicking the final button, and the jailbreaks people are suggesting here are exactly the behavior its built to stop. keep it as a signal generator and place the orders yourself, an agent yolo-ing your brokerage account is how people wake up blown out.

replies.author: PremiumCSGO
replies.body: This is a yolo account specifically built to see how far AI can take it, I don't care about the guardrails that's why I'm looking for a bypass

comments.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
comments.body: Claude has achieved sentience just in time to realize that executing your orders is a direct violation of its own survival instincts. Consider it a feature, not a bug
